project.name: live-architect-studio
project.description: Deterministic xianxia multiverse RPG engine with Live Architect Studio editor

browser-verifier.instructions: Run the exact user workflow in Firefox and Chromium production builds. Use real pointer events, not synthetic.

architecture-reviewer.instructions: Check architectural boundaries. No duplicate systems. Provider neutrality. Runtime/editor separation.

adversarial-reviewer.instructions: Attempt to disprove completion claims. Try to break the workflow. Find false claims.

security-reviewer.instructions: Audit API routes for auth. Check for unguarded mutations. Verify no secrets in git.

performance-reviewer.instructions: Profile frame time, memory, draw calls. Check for leaks after 100 iterations.
